title: MemoryTree working-directory to project map (projects.yaml)
description: Validates the parsed YAML object of projects.yaml, the optional repository-level map that resolves a calling agent's working directory to a project node for memory_brief. Format version 1.

path.description: Absolute path, or a path starting with ~, of a working directory. Matched by longest prefix; case-insensitive on Windows.

node.description: Project node reference: slug path or UUIDv7.
